claims.claim: The renewal fee covering patent years 7 to 10 is NIS 1,921 and is due before the end of the sixth year from the application date, not before the seventh anniversary.
claims.raw_snippet: עם הגשת בקשת חידוש לפני תום השנה השישית מתאריך הבקשה לפטנט, לתקופה נוספת של ארבע שנים 1,921

claims.claim: The lump-sum renewal covering patent years 1 to 6 is NIS 961 and is due within three months of the grant of the patent.
claims.raw_snippet: עם הגשת בקשת חידוש לפני תום שלושה חודשים מיום מתן הפטנט, עד תום שש שנים מתאריך הבקשה לפטנט 961

claims.claim: An all-inclusive renewal fee of NIS 14,410 may be paid within three months of grant to keep the patent in force for its entire term.
claims.raw_snippet: אגרת חידוש כוללת לתשלום לפני תום שלושה חודשים מיום מתן הפטנט כדי שיהיה בתוקף לכל תקופתו 14,410

claims.claim: An additional filing fee of NIS 300 applies for every 50 pages of a patent application from page 101 onward, excluding genetic sequences from the page count.
claims.raw_snippet: אגרת הגשה נוספת בעד כל 50 עמודים שבבקשה לפטנט החל בעמוד ה-101; במספר העמודים לא יימנו רצפים גנטיים 300

claims.claim: A qualifying applicant pays 60% of the filing fee. Qualifying applicants are any applicant that is not a company or partnership, a company or partnership whose turnover in the preceding year did not exceed NIS 10 million, an institution recognised under section 9 of the Council for Higher Education Law 5718-1958, or a technology transfer company wholly owned by such an institution, and in each case only when filing a first patent application for a particular invention.
claims.raw_snippet: ואולם מבקש שאינו חברה ואינו שותפות, או חברה או שותפות שמחזור עסקיה בשנה הקודמת לא עלה על 10 מיליון שקלים חדשים, או מוסד שהוכר לפי סעיף 9 לחוק המועצה להשכלה גבוהה, התשי"ח-1958 או חברה למסחור טכנולוגיה שהיא בבעלות מלאה של מוסד כאמור, אשר עיסוקה בהגנה ובניהול של הקניין הרוחני הנובע מאמצאות אשר פותחו באותו מוסד, המגישים בעד אמצאה מסוימת בקשה ראשונה לפטנט ישלמו 60% מהסכום

claims.claim: Accelerated examination fees differ by requester: an applicant request under s.19a(a)(3) to (6) is NIS 357 plus NIS 834 for the examination, totalling NIS 1,191, while a third-party request under s.19a(c) is NIS 11,910 plus NIS 5,955, totalling NIS 17,865.
claims.raw_snippet: (1) עם הגשת בקשה לפי סעיף 19א(א)(3) עד (6) לחוק 357 (2) עם הגשת בקשה לפי סעיף 19א(ג) לחוק 11,910

claims.claim: A request to extend any deadline under sections 48d(c) and 164 of the Patents Law, or regulations 5(a) or 87(c), costs NIS 240 per month or part of a month.
claims.raw_snippet: עם הגשת בקשה להארכת כל מועד, לפי סעיפים 48ד(ג) ו-164 לחוק או בקשה לפי תקנות 5(א) או 87(ג), בעד כל חודש או חלק ממנו 240

claims.claim: Patent Term Extension fees form a ladder: NIS 4,180 before the end of the first extension year, NIS 5,016 before the second, NIS 6,019 before the third, and NIS 7,223 before the fourth.
claims.raw_snippet: אגרת הארכה (תקנה 7 (א)(2)) (א) לפני תום שנת הארכה ראשונה 4,180 (ב) לפני תום שנת הארכה שנייה 5,016 (ג) לפני תום שנת הארכה שלישית 6,019 (ד) לפני תום שנת הארכה רביעית 7,223

claims.claim: ILPO acting as International Searching Authority charges a search fee of NIS 4,203, and the transmittal fee under regulation 6(e) is NIS 656.
claims.raw_snippet: אגרת חיפוש המשתלמת לרשות הפטנטים כרשות חיפוש בין-לאומית לפי תקנה 6(ד) לתקנות הפטנטים 4,203 אגרת מסירה לפי תקנה 6(ה) לתקנות יישום האמנה 656

claims.claim: Under section 132 of the Israeli Patents Law a service invention belongs to the employer by default, and under section 134 an employee may apply to the Compensation and Royalties Committee at ILPO to determine entitlement to compensation where the parties have not agreed.
claims.raw_snippet: Section 132 establishes a default setting whereby an invention made by an employee during the period of his employment and as a result of his employment (a service invention) belongs to the employer. Under section 134, if the parties have not agreed on compensation for a service invention, the employee may ask the Compensation and Royalties Committee to establish if he is entitled to compensation and if so, how much.

claims.claim: Chapter Six of the Israeli Patents Law (sections 94 to 113) governs inventions of defence interest: such inventions must be brought to the attention of the Minister of Defence, may be subject to a secrecy order, and may not be filed abroad without permission.
claims.raw_snippet: Patents Law 5727-1967, Chapter Six: Inventions Requiring Secrecy, sections 94 to 113, governing notification to the Minister of Defence, secrecy orders, and the prohibition on filing such applications abroad without permission.

claims.claim: The Patents Law (Amendment No. 15) Bill, 5786-2025 was published by the Israeli government on 30 December 2025.
claims.raw_snippet: On December 30, 2025, the Israeli government published the Patent Law (Amendment No. 15) Bill-2025, representing the most comprehensive overhaul of Israel's patent system in decades.

claims.claim: Amendment 15 proposes an examination-on-request system with a mandatory 4-year deadline from filing.
claims.raw_snippet: The amendment proposes transitioning to an 'examination on request' system, with examination of a patent application commencing only upon filing a 'Request for Examination' within four years from the application filing date.

claims.claim: Amendment 15 proposes introducing a new domestic provisional application route in Israel, which today has no US-style provisional.
claims.raw_snippet: A new 'provisional application' route will allow applicants to secure an early filing date under relaxed formal requirements.

claims.claim: Amendment 15 proposes a statutory 12-month grace period for inventor-originated pre-filing disclosures.
claims.raw_snippet: According to the proposed amendment, the grace period for prior disclosure will be set to 12 months, and an inventor's right to obtain a patent will not be prejudiced by a disclosure made within 12 months prior to the filing date of the application, provided the disclosure was made by the inventor or with their consent.

claims.claim: Amendment 15 expands third-party observations so they may be submitted throughout the entire examination period, not only in narrow current windows.
claims.raw_snippet: Third parties would be permitted to submit observations and prior art to the examiner throughout the entire examination period.

claims.claim: Most Amendment 15 provisions would take effect one month after publication, while examination-on-request, provisional applications, and confidential prior-use protections would take effect one year after publication.
claims.raw_snippet: Many provisions will take effect one month after publication, while provisions on examination-on-request, provisional applications, and confidential prior use will take effect one year later.

claims.claim: The ILPO official 2026 fee schedule is published at gov.il/he/pages/ilpo-fees, effective 1 January 2026.
claims.raw_snippet: לוח אגרות רשות הפטנטים, התעריפים בתוקף מיום 1 בינואר 2026 (פורסם באתר רשמי gov.il).

claims.claim: According to the ILPO 2024 Annual Report, the average filing-to-end-of-examination time is around 43 months overall, around 51.3 months for biotechnology, and around 39.3 months for mechanical/electronics/physics applications.
claims.raw_snippet: According to the last published Annual Report of the ILPO for 2024, the average time from the filing of an application until the end of examination is 43 months. Different technological fields average different amounts of time, with examination of applications in biotechnology being the longest (on average 51.3 months from filing of the application) and mechanics, electronics and physics being the shortest (on average 39.3 months from the filing of the application).

claims.claim: The ISA/IL international search fee is USD 1,333 effective 1 March 2026, per the WIPO PCT Applicant's Guide Israel chapter.
claims.raw_snippet: The new dollar amount of the search fee required by the ILPO (Israel Patent Office) when acting as an International Searching Authority is $1,333 and will go into effect March 1, 2026.

claims.claim: Israel is a contracting state of the Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT) and ILPO acts as Receiving Office, ISA, and IPEA; country-specific requirements appear in the WIPO PCT Applicant's Guide, Israel chapter.
claims.raw_snippet: PCT Applicant's Guide - Israel - country chapter maintained by WIPO with Israel-specific filing requirements, ISA/IPEA elections, fee amounts in USD, and national-phase information.

claims.claim: The Israel Patent Office portal is at gov.il/en/departments/israel_patent_office (English) and gov.il/he/departments/israel_patent_office (Hebrew).
claims.raw_snippet: Israel Patent Office - official portal on gov.il publishes patent forms, fees, ISA/IPEA notices, the annual report, and the legislative process status.

claims.claim: As of May 2026, the Amendment 15 bill is in the Knesset Constitution, Law and Justice Committee following its first reading; it is not yet enacted.
claims.raw_snippet: The bill will proceed to the Knesset's Constitution, Law and Justice Committee following its first reading.
